title: 第一卷第21章 这个柳莺太喜欢装了第一卷第22章 懂不懂什么叫魔修哪个魔修会救人
content_zh:
小院。
厢房内。
“薛老！”
李总管急得满头是汗，连声音都有些颤抖。
“您……可有法子救救殿下？”
“难！”
看着对面盘膝而坐，双目紧闭，周身被一层火意包绕的七皇子，薛神医摇摇头，“我只能将寒毒暂时压制，根本无法根除，可你也知道，他寒毒早已深入骨髓，与他合二为一，每次压制，必将引起反弹，如今老夫……已经力不从心了。”
顿了顿。
他叹了口气。
“这次，我还能勉力压制，可下次爆发……唉！”
“殿下！”
李总管自然明白他话里的意思，竟是忍不住落了泪。
“可怜皇妃她仅有殿下这一个子嗣，若是殿下出了什么岔子，咱家万死难赎其罪！”
“李总管。”
正在此时。
一道虚弱的声音传了过来。
“你不必伤心，我自己的情况自己清楚，这些年若非你和薛老为我奔波，我怎么可能会活到今日？便是母妃泉下有知，也不会怪你的。”
却是七皇子幽幽醒来。
“殿下……”
李总管不忍再看他。

“说起来。”
险死还生捡回一条命，七皇子似也看开了生死，有些感慨，“今日我倒是见到了一个很有趣的人，巧的很，薛老您也认识他……”
……
外间。
“啊，柳……”
阿傻神色一喜，刚要打招呼，只是突然想到一个月前她对顾寒的态度，小脸突然耷拉了下来，气哼哼地转过了头。
“顾寒。”
柳莺的声音一如既往的清冷。
“你的事情我听说了。”
“是么，你的消息倒是很灵通。”
“你来这里做什么？”
“呵呵，这就不是柳大小姐该管的事了吧！”
柳莺的眉头皱了皱。
她已经笃定。
顾寒这么巧出现在这里，一定是投靠了七皇子！
“给你个忠告。”
她语气平淡，可却带着一丝居高临下的意味。
“做人最要紧的就是守好本分，不能越矩。你先前的祸患，也正是因为你风头太过。若是你再不知收敛，就算侥幸能躲过这次，也躲不过下次。”
“装！”
顾寒冷笑一声。

“我顾寒如何行事，轮不到你来指手画脚！”
“言尽于此，听不听在你。”
说完。
content_en:
Small courtyard.
In the wing room.
"Mr. Xue!"
Manager Li was so anxious that his head was covered with sweat, and even his voice was trembling.
"Do you... have any way to save His Highness?"
"Difficult!"
Looking at the Seventh Prince who was sitting cross-legged opposite him with his eyes closed and his whole body surrounded by a layer of fire, Divine Doctor Xue shook his head, "I can only temporarily suppress the cold poison, but it cannot be eradicated at all. But you also know that his cold poison has already penetrated into his bone marrow and become one with him. Every time he suppresses it, it will inevitably cause a rebound. Now I... am no longer able to do what I want."
There was a pause.
He sighed.
"This time, I can still suppress it with all my strength, but next time it breaks out... ugh!"
"Your Highness!"
Manager Li naturally understood the meaning of his words and couldn't help crying.
"It's a pity that the imperial concubine only has one heir, Your Highness. If something goes wrong with Your Highness, our family will never be able to redeem it!"
"Manager Li."
At this moment.
A weak voice came over.
"You don't have to be sad. I know my own situation well. If you and Mr. Xue hadn't been running for me all these years, how could I have survived to this day? Even if my mother and concubine knew what I was doing, I wouldn't blame you."
But it was the Seventh Prince who woke up faintly.
"Your Highness..."
Manager Li couldn't bear to look at him anymore.
"Speak of it."
After narrowly avoiding death and saving a life, the Seventh Prince seemed to have looked away from life and death and said with some emotion, "I did meet a very interesting person today. What a coincidence, Mr. Xue also knows him..."
…
outside room.
"Ah, Liu..."
Ah Sha looked happy, and was about to say hello, but suddenly thought of her attitude towards Gu Han a month ago, her face suddenly drooped, and she turned her head away angrily.
"Gu Han."
Liu Ying's voice was as cold as ever.
"I heard about you."
"Yes, you are quite well informed."
"What are you doing here?"
"Haha, this is not Miss Liu's business, right?"
Liu Ying frowned.
She was determined.
Gu Han appeared here so coincidentally, he must have taken refuge with the Seventh Prince!
"I'll give you a piece of advice."
Her tone was calm, but there was a hint of condescension in it.
"The most important thing in life is to keep one's duty and not to overstep the rules. Your previous troubles were precisely because you were too popular. If you don't know how to restrain yourself, even if you are lucky enough to escape this time, you will not be able to escape next time."
"Pretend!"
Gu Han laughed.
"It's not your turn to dictate how I, Gu Han, behave!"
"That's it. It's up to you whether you listen or not."
Finished.
